issue.title: Rendering tests fail when the ambient TERM is dumb (agent/ToolRun shells): 16 scoped-check nodes are not hermetic against TERM
issue.description:
Rendering contract tests are not hermetic against the ambient TERM: under `TERM=dumb` (as set in agent/ToolRun shells) at least five, and in the reporting run sixteen, scoped-check nodes fail; with any real TERM they pass. Root cause reproduced by the sase-1lh lander (proposal from phase sase-1lh.1 note #3).

Reproduction on master 97825eee1d, Python 3.14.7 `.venv`:

```sh
T=(tests/test_plan_pending_selector.py::test_color_contract_force_color tests/test_bead/test_cli_show_style_units.py tests/test_final_status_command.py::test_status_pretty_renders_e2e_fixture tests/update_progress/test_render_live.py::test_narrow_width_ellipsizes tests/test_vcs_log_progress.py::test_interactive_fetch_progress_uses_transient_spinner)
env -u NO_COLOR TERM=dumb .venv/bin/pytest -q $T             # 5 failed, 18 passed
env -u NO_COLOR TERM=xterm-256color .venv/bin/pytest -q $T   # 23 passed
env NO_COLOR=1 TERM=xterm-256color .venv/bin/pytest -q $T    # 23 passed
```

So `TERM=dumb`, not `NO_COLOR`, is the trigger (Rich treats a dumb terminal as non-color / non-interactive, and these tests assume the default capability). Full failing set from ToolRun 5f64cd65bb65fc90d30bd9f15bfc91a7 (gate-fix phase, run with NO_COLOR=1 TERM=dumb; identical 16 failures on clean e69c455bd6):

- tests/update_progress/test_log_sink_fanout_session.py::test_select_renderer_modes
- tests/test_plan_pending_selector.py::test_color_contract_force_color
- tests/test_bead/test_clan_summary_epic_bead_script.py::test_markdown_helper_renders_semantic_styles_and_safe_markup
- tests/test_vcs_log_progress.py::test_interactive_fetch_progress_uses_transient_spinner
- tests/main/test_repo_log.py::test_repo_log_summary_renders_external_kind
- tests/update_progress/test_render_live.py::test_narrow_width_ellipsizes
- tests/ace/tui/test_plan_decision_ace_render_cards.py::test_decision_cards_never_clip_with_stylesheet
- tests/update_progress/test_timeline_renderer_fixes.py::test_live_print_final_leaves_later_stdout_intact
- tests/ace/tui/modals/test_preview_search.py::test_wrapped_row_offsets_agree_with_rich_syntax_render[...]
- tests/test_bead/test_cli_show_style_units.py::test_resolve_detail_style_gate_matrix[auto-auto-True-rich]
- tests/test_final_status_command.py::test_status_pretty_renders_e2e_fixture
  (plus parametrizations, 16 total)

CI is green on these because GitHub runners do not export TERM=dumb. Fix direction: normalize TERM (and clear NO_COLOR/FORCE_COLOR) for the test session in a conftest autouse fixture, or have each rendering test pin its terminal env with monkeypatch; do not weaken the color/width assertions.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Deterministic: the five sampled nodes fail every time under TERM=dumb and pass every time under TERM=xterm-256color on the same tree; ToolRun 5f64cd65 and a clean-base rerun on e69c455bd6 both produced the identical 16 failures.

issue.creation_reason: Proposed by phase sase-1lh.1 (epic sase-1lh) as 16 local scoped-check failures; the sase-1lh lander root-caused them to the ambient TERM=dumb and no existing task covers it.
